attchmntText: Rain Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Rain Industries Limited published unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and declared a second interim dividend. The Board approved the consolidated results on November 6, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations was 54,859.03 million, with a net profit attributable to owners of 2,106.58 million. Earnings per share were 6.26. The Board declared a second interim dividend of 25 percent, or Rs. 0.50 per equity share, for the financial year ending December 31, 2026. The record date for this dividend is November 13, 2026. The announcement also included newspaper clippings of these results and the dividend notice. Siemens Limited also approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 6, 2026.
